rationale.consistency: Uses the existing `existing` parameter pattern from parseOptCertIssuer, slices helpers already imported, and Caddy's conversational comment style; no exported API changes.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil options, invalid directive/positional (errors before any state is touched), chained order options in one file, First/Last/Before/After, and falls back to plugin order when options lacks a valid []string.
rationale.scope: All edits serve the requirement; the RegisterDirectiveOrder rewrite and options clone go slightly past the minimum but are justified by 'default order never mutated' and shared-map safety. Silently deleting a caller-supplied 'order' key is a small semantic change.
rationale.readability: Threading `order []string` through buildSubroute (nil = keep written order) is clearer than the old bool; directiveOrderFor centralizes lookup. Comments are somewhat chatty but explain the non-obvious ownership.
rationale.robustness: No global writes after init; parseOptOrder clones before DeleteFunc, options map is cloned so shared/reused maps can't race or leak state; also fixes the latent append-into-defaultDirectiveOrder backing array bug.
rationale.maintainability: Explicit order parameter removes hidden dependence on package state; per-adaptation order lives in options['order'] which is string-keyed coupling but matches existing conventions.
